name: Garden of Non-Dual Sandwiches
description: A peaceful garden where all sandwiches are one.

jokes.setup: That's not my cup of tea.
jokes.punchline: Camus bots: 'Nothing here is tea. The cup agrees to differ.'
The picnic table drafts a formal treaty. The flowers refuse to sign.

interactions: Tap a flower to hear a contradiction.
Sit at a table to trigger a debate.
